snippet.title: Wheel Make It | Playtest | Gameplay PC
snippet.description:
One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos.
Wheel Make It is a solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

FUN PHYSICS
Momentum, friction, and collisions dictate how the wheelchair moves. Mastering balance and timing is the only way to survive.

VARIED LEVELS & OBSTACLES
Maneuver through tight corridors, moving platforms, traps, and chaotic environments designed to push your coordination to the limit.

UNIQUE CO-OP GAMEPLAY
Two players share control of one wheelchair, testing your ability to sync up under pressure.

PROGRESSIVE DIFFICULTY
Levels ramp up in complexity, introducing new hazards and mechanics that demand sharper teamwork.

OTHER FEATURES
Singleplayer Mode: Test your limits in a singleplayer mode, where you take the full controll of the both wheels.

Leaderboards: Track your speed with leaderboards that compare completion times across different player configurations.

Friendship on the Line: Laugh, scream, and argue as you and your partner struggle to stay in sync.

Player Customization: Unlock and equip different skins to personalize your character
